items.item: PF-001/PF-037 requests are created idempotently per requester and key; a reused key with different content is a conflict; replays write no second event
tests: PF-001/037 create is idempotent per (owner,key); a reused key with a different prompt is refused

items.item: PF-003 compare-and-swap on the request pointer; state change and its event commit together (outbox) or not at all
tests: PF-003 compare-and-swap: a stale writer gets VERSION_CONFLICT with the current version and nothing is written
the state change and its event commit together: a failing event rolls the state back
events are dense per request, ordered, deduplicated by id, and the outbox tracks sync

items.item: PF-002 request state machine with declared transitions only, terminal states final, one event per move
tests: PF-002 lifecycle: only declared transitions, terminal states are final, every move writes one event

items.item: Decisions, candidates and evidence are immutable and bound to the exact candidate
tests: decisions are immutable; supersession is a new record and only the latest is active
candidates keep their binding; evidence is bound to the exact candidate and immutable

items.item: PF-039 ready/blocked flags follow blockers; S10 advanceWizard moves the view only, bounded by state, with a workspace version check
tests: blockers flip readiness; clearing them restores READY; the workspace version moves with each change
S10 advanceWizard moves the view only, is bounded by state, and rejects a stale workspace version

items.item: AT-27/AT-48 crash reconciliation drops stopped jobs, blocks their tasks and records why; resume is idempotent
tests: AT-27/48 crash reconciliation: jobs that stopped are dropped, their tasks blocked, and the event says why
reconcileAll skips finished requests and reports the ones it fixed

items.item: AT-48 outbox delivery to the GitHub issue trail (pending/sent/failed state exists; the sender is task 2.O)
items.needs: task 2.O (issue trail) sends events from the outbox
